description: This file contains utility functions and classes for testing address tracking on Linux, including netlink message creation and manipulation, specifically for the Chromium project.

classes.name: NetlinkMessage
classes.description: A class for constructing and managing netlink messages with methods for adding payloads and attributes, and appending to buffers.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for comparing two ifaddrmsg structures.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::NetlinkMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the netlink message buffer with a header.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::AddPayload
methods.description: Adds payload data to the netlink message buffer.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::AddAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute with type and data to the netlink message.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::AppendTo
methods.description: Appends the constructed netlink message to an output buffer.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::Append
methods.description: Appends raw data to the netlink message buffer.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::Align
methods.description: Aligns the buffer size and updates the message length.

methods.name: MakeAddrMessageWithCacheInfo
methods.description: Creates a netlink address message with cache info and appends it to output.

methods.name: MakeAddrMessage
methods.description: Creates a netlink address message with default cache info.

methods.name: MakeLinkMessage
methods.description: Creates a link netlink message with specified flags and index.

methods.name: MakeWirelessLinkMessage
methods.description: Creates a wireless link netlink message, typically to be ignored.
